dialogues.speaker: Bizerte
dialogues.text: Captain, do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Bizerte
dialogues.text: Because Her Majesty the King, the revered "Boss" herself, has personally advised me to help the people around me.

dialogues.speaker: Bizerte
dialogues.text: And, well... You're around me. You're right here. Right there.

dialogues.speaker: Bizerte
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, that was just me trying to liven things up a little, ahem... Anyway, I think we should head out and see if the residents of the city need our assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Montagne
dialogues.text: Good idea. I will lead the way.
